question: Why do these teachers fail to obtain Śiva initiation?
premises: all are colored by attachment to knowledge
they are bound by Māyā bond
therefore they do not obtain Śiva initiation
inference: Attachment and bondage prevent attainment of Śiva initiation.
plain_english: All Buddhists, Arhats, and others are colored by attachment to knowledge; because they are bound by the Māyā bond, they do not obtain Śiva initiation.
